newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Burglars dig tunnel, rob bank in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Burglars dig tunnel, rob bank in Argentina.

text.p: Burglars dug a 150-foot (50 yard) tunnel beneath a busy street in a thriving Buenos Aires neighbourhoods and robbed more than 100 safes from a bank, the bank and the police said on Monday.
The burglars rented an empty shop a few feet from a police station in Recoleta neighbourhood and dug over several months to break into the vault of Banco de Credito Argentino.
The robbery was done over the weekend but was discovered Monday when the bank's employees returned to work.
"They robbed a minimum percentage as they robbed a bit more than 100 safes and in the vault there are more than 1,000," an official from the bank told reporters.
A police officer said the amount robbed was $1 million.

"They are proffesionals. No doubt. They dug an almost perfect tunnel. They covered its walls with wood pieces and took away the earth with a little cart and put it in small bags", he said. "It was meticulously planned since at least six months." No arrests were made.
